items.title: Herb Morand Interview, 1950-03-12
items.q: Well, Joe McCoy and myself, he's the one that sings Old Red, and just called, you know, formed a band together, him and I.

ctx.x: But you didn't, you didn't get much royalty from Decca from that, did you? No, no.

Decca, like Old Red, was a, was a hit. I went down to Decca Studios to make a, to have an audition. Let them hear the band. Well, at that time, all the boys was anxious to record and everything. So we played Old Red for an audition number and they decided to record it. Well, Joe McCoy and myself, he's the one that sings Old Red, and just called, you know, formed a band together, him and I. And I told them it would be a wrong move to, to do any recording without a contract or anything. So they all decided to go on…
And following, following that you recorded some other tunes that were equally successful. Right.
